g.text: Cyclic view: one ring per ISO year (W01 at top, clockwise).
Circles = peak week of each season; full colour = selected range

rect.style: stroke-width: 1.16; stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter; fill: #999999; fill-opacity: 0.25;

g.text: Linear view: whole series; grey band = selected range highlighted in the circle
No: before 2020 the season peak fell in ISO weeks 05-12 (Feb-Mar), but since 2022/23 it has jumped between December and February (W50, W50, W07, W06), so the peak week shifts from year to year.
Data: Robert Koch-Institut, ARE-Praxis-Sentinel (CC BY 4.0), Germany, all ages. Static figure: the 'selection' is fixed to the last three complete seasons.
Does the acute respiratory illness (ARE) peak in Germany fall in the same week every year?
